claim: An assignment and independent acceptance evidence meet at a selected admission boundary; rejected and interrupted work remain repairable.
topology: An illustrative workflow progresses from priority to design, work order, agent implementation, acceptance gate, and integrated work. Engineering models supply scope and context to the work order and obligations to the gate. Independent acceptance evidence feeds the gate separately. Rejected work returns for repair; unresolved judgment goes to a human. An interrupted agent preserves durable commits and partial artifacts for recovery to inspect before resuming.
bw_encoding: Square boxes identify artifacts; rounded boxes identify activities; a diamond identifies the acceptance decision; double outline identifies independent evidence. All fills remain white.
redesign: Author-requested illustrative workflow at a selected integration-admission boundary, not a universal DocAble schedule. Separate independent acceptance evidence from the producer, retain repair and judgment outcomes, and preserve interrupted work for recovery.
